protocol.artifacts: exclusive output; ArtifactStore per run, verified export; reports.jsonl.gz full exports; summary.json including compact per-run outcomes/costs/failure taxonomy
protocol.contracts: Original QASM parsed independently before mutation; zero input. Qiskit trusted reference oracle. Z distribution tol .15; top12 nonidentity Pauli |expectation|>=.2 tol .2; target infidelity tol .2.
protocol.measurement_mode: measurement_only; no hidden truth or candidate state passed to analyst
protocol.name: external-qasmbench-v1
protocol.policy_compatibility: Template threshold not defined for arbitrary contracts; complementary_schedule is the existing simple predetermined baseline. No invented threshold comparator.

recovery.criterion: fresh candidate upper normalized loss<=1 and fresh original lower>candidate upper

protocol.statistics: Per-investigation alpha=.01, existing union bounds; descriptive run and architecture aggregates only. Seeds are not independent architectures. No population confidence interval, bootstrap, or superiority claim.
protocol.success: Detection compared against exact operational contract violation. No discrepancy does not establish equivalence. Attribution stays ambiguous. Recovery success covers only declared claims and one input.
protocol.time_limit: 120 seconds per recovery, checked between jobs; each diagnostic bounded by 16 executions of at most5 qubits32 gates
